chunks: Salih ibn 'Uqbah narrated from Yunus al-Shaybani, who said:

I was present, along with Abu Shibl, before Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, so I asked him about these issues concerning blood-money. Then Abu Shibl asked, and he was more intense in pressing the matter, so I left him until he had exhausted it thoroughly.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, before whom the questions were asked
key_terms.اسْتَنْظَفَ: he exhausted the matter thoroughly in asking and clarifying
key_terms.الدِّيَاتِ: blood-money; financial compensation in cases of injury or killing
key_terms.الْمَسَائِلِ: the legal questions or issues being asked about
key_terms.مُبَالَغَةً: intensity or insistence in pursuing the questioning

ai.seo_question: How were questions about blood-money presented to Imam Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام in hadith reports?
ai.summary: This report describes a session in which questions were put to Imam Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام regarding matters of blood-money. It reflects the transmission of jurisprudential knowledge through direct questioning and careful inquiry before the Imam عليه السلام.
